unassigned_dimensions.note: printed top-right of the site plan; its left tick does not align with grid 4's drop-line (off by roughly the width of the ซักล้าง roof-drain box) — read as the concrete drain-channel's own call-out length, not a grid-axis tick

unassigned_dimensions.label: แนวดิ่งใกล้เสา C1 ชั้นบน (ใกล้มุม ง'/1)
unassigned_dimensions.source_image: image/บ้าน_ใหญ่_2ชั้น_02/บ้าน_ใหญ่_2ชั้น_02_หน้า19.png
unassigned_dimensions.note: both ends are plain × ticks (no grid bubble reference) between the top wall corner near ง' and column C1's B2 beam corner — could not be confidently traced to a known line or arithmetically anchored from one without guessing; recorded as an unpositioned edge-type dimension per rule 4, not converted to a dummy line

warnings: SWEEP SCOPE, STATED PLAINLY: for every axis-bearing page this sweep transcribed (a) the main grid-bubble-to-grid-bubble chain with its printed total, and (b) any secondary sub-chain whose ticks could be confidently anchored (arithmetically, to the millimetre) to an already-known grid line or to another tick within the same printed row. It did NOT individually chase every tertiary wall-face / door-jamb / opening dimension buried inside room interiors on the floor plans (หน้า05, หน้า06, หน้า19, หน้า21 in particular each carry additional wall-face offset columns, e.g. หน้า06's '0.80/0.90', '0.80/0.85/1.20', '1.10/0.50/0.85' clusters near the ก/ข corner, and หน้า21's '0.80/2.00/1.20/0.65/0.65' column beside the main y-chain) at full pixel precision. These are real printed numbers, not invented, but going tick-by-tick through every interior partition dimension on a scanned 1:100 sheet across this many pages was judged disproportionate to rule 4's stated purpose (recovering missing structural/floor-edge grid lines) and a real source of mis-transcription risk from a blurry scan. Flagged here per instruction to say so rather than guess, so the gap is visible rather than silently folded into 'swept'.

The 'A' dimension on the site plan (หน้า04, top-left, from the property line to grid 1) is a symbolic/variable call-out — the sheet's own notes read 'A = ระยะปรับตามขนาดที่ดิน แต่ไม่น้อยกว่า 3 ม.' (adjusts with lot size, not less than 3 m) — it carries no fixed printed value_m, so it was not recorded in unassigned_dimensions (which requires an actual printed number) nor turned into a dummy line.

New x-axis dummies @-1.00 and @9.70 (the roof eave overhang beyond grid 1 and grid 4) are corroborated independently on three separate sheets (หน้า07 รูปด้าน1, หน้า08 รูปด้าน3, หน้า09 รูปตัดก — all print the same 1.00 m eave stub at both ends of the 8.70 m grid run) — high confidence. New x-axis dummies @3.90/@5.30 (window jamb under the 2.20 m bay) and @7.50/@8.30 (window/door jamb under the 3.00 m bay), both from หน้า05 only, are single-sheet reads — moderate confidence; if op_fix's downstream consumers want a second source before promoting these to named dummies, none was found on this pass.

หน้า19's isolated '1.40' vertical tick (near column C1 / grid ง', beam-plan view) and หน้า04's '2.00' drainage-channel call-out could not be positioned with confidence and were left as unassigned_dimensions / an edge-type entry respectively rather than guessed into a line — see their notes above.

This house's grid master already carries named printed prime bubbles ง'/ค' (real drawing labels, not dummies) per its own warnings — this sweep transcribed every chain using those printed ids verbatim and did not rename or re-sequence anything; that is gridfix.py's job, not this sweep's.

DECISION (op_fix, 2026-09-30, ยืนยันด้วยภาพจริง — ครอปซูมแถบมิติซ้าย): agent อ่าน chain ของหน้า27 (แปลนสุขาภิบาลชั้นบน) ผิด — รายงาน ง' to ง = 2.0 เฉยๆ แต่เส้นจริงมี 2 ช่วงซ้อนกัน (2.00 แล้วต่อ 0.80 อีกที ก่อนถึง ง) รวม 2.80 ตรงกับทุกหน้าอื่นในบ้านนี้ (04/05/06/07/08/09/19/20/21/25 ทั้งหมดให้ 2.8) และผลรวม ง'->ก ที่พิมพ์ไว้เอง (11.40) ก็ลงตัวพอดีกับ 2.8+4.0+3.0+1.6=11.4 เท่านั้น (ไม่ใช่ 2.0+...) แก้ค่าใน chain ของหน้า27 เป็น 2.8 แล้ว
